## Signing the CLA

This pull request adds a signature record to the central ledger. Use `sign.ts` to generate the file, then open the
pull request from the authenticated signer account.

- [ ] I have read the current CLA, and the record contains its SHA-256 hash.
- [ ] The path and GitHub account ID match the authenticated signer.
- [ ] I have authority to grant these rights.

The automated validator checks the exact record format. A maintainer reviews
and merges the record to accept it.
